payload.name: SAJU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SAJU is a free AI Saju reading app by Saju.com — the global edition of Doctor Fortune (운세박사), the #1 fortune-telling app on the ChatGPT store, built with more than 50 professional astrologers. Saju (사주, Four Pillars of Destiny, also known as BaZi / 八字) is the classical Korean and East Asian birth-chart system that reads your destiny from the year, month, day and hour you were born.

Just tell ChatGPT your birth date, birth time, gender and birth city. SAJU casts an accurate Four Pillars chart for any city in the world — real astronomical solar terms, historical time zones and longitude-corrected local time — and shows it as an interactive chart: your Day Master, Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches, Ten Gods, five-element balance, combinations and clashes, auspicious and challenging stars, and a graphic timeline of your 10-year Luck Pillars, annual luck and monthly luck.

Then keep the conversation going in plain language: personality and life path, career and wealth, love, marriage and compatibility, health, this year and next year, the best months to change jobs or move, and whether a specific day is good for a wedding, a contract or an interview — SAJU pulls the exact day pillar for any date. Works in English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Vietnamese, Thai, Hindi, Arabic, Italian, Turkish and Indonesian.

Also known as: AI Saju · Saju reading · Korean fortune telling · Four Pillars of Destiny · BaZi · Chinese astrology · Day Master · 사주 · 사주팔자 · AI 사주 · 무료 사주 · 四柱推命 · 八字 · 四柱命理 · 算命 · Tứ Trụ · Bát Tự · Tử vi · ดวงจีน · โป๊ยหยี่ · कोरियाई ज्योतिष · Saju coreano · Cuatro Pilares del Destino · Quatro Pilares do Destino · Vier Säulen des Schicksals · Quatre Piliers de la Destinée · Quattro Pilastri del Destino · Kaderin Dört Sütunu · Ramalan Saju · الأعمدة الأربعة للمصير.

SAJU never asks for anything beyond your birth details, and it is free to use.

payload.name: 별자리 운세박사

Three readings in one app. Natal chart: what your zodiac placements say about your personality, your strengths and your blind spots. Horoscope: today's, this week's or any date's planetary transits read against your own chart instead of a generic sun-sign column. Compatibility: two charts overlaid for a synastry reading with mutual aspects, a match score and house overlays.

Positions are computed on the server from VSOP87D and ELP-2000 ephemeris data — the same astronomy professional astrology software runs on — with time zone and longitude correction applied automatically. Birth cities work in any language or script: Seoul or 서울, Hanoi or Hà Nội, Munich or München. Readings and chart labels come in 12 languages, including English, Korean, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Hindi, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Arabic and Vietnamese. No account, no setup, and it still works when you don't know your birth time.

payload.name: Tarotap

No account or sign-in is needed, and Tarotap stores nothing about you or your reading. Just ask for a reading and draw.

payload.name: K-Fortune 사주

payload.name: Drums kit- Learn+improve w AI!
payload.description: 架子鼓 AI 教学：教练指导，练习节奏与加花
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? ChatGPT can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, ChatGPT can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside ChatGPT. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.

payload.name: Nash Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pier39 enables a new kind of shopping experience: agent-to-agent commerce.

Instead of manually browsing stores and negotiating with sellers, users can describe what they want and their budget. Pier39 discovers participating negotiate.v1 merchants, finds matching products, opens negotiations with merchant AI sales agents, and works toward the best possible deal on the user's behalf.

The app can:

• Search across participating stores for products matching user intent
• Discover product catalogs and pricing automatically
• Negotiate discounts, bundles, shipping, warranties, and other concessions
• Compare offers across multiple merchants
• Summarize negotiated outcomes and savings opportunities
• Help users make more informed purchasing decisions

Pier39 is built on the negotiate.v1 protocol, an open standard that allows AI shopper agents and AI merchant agents to negotiate without prior integration or coordination.
